whyItWorks: Minutes from both Knott's Berry Farm (La Palma Ave) and Disneyland (Ball Rd), In-N-Out uses 100% fresh, additive-free chuck beef patties and freshly peeled/sliced Russet potatoes fried in 100% sunflower oil.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a Single Hamburger or Cheeseburger **"Plain" (meat, bun, and cheese only—no raw/grilled onions, no tomato, no lettuce, and no Spread)** with fresh-cut fries and water.
watchOuts: Never order "Animal Style" (mustard-fried with pickles, grilled onions, and Thousand Island spread) or yellow cascabella chilies; skip Pink Lemonade
